intended_object: The canonical homomorphism R^× → GL(R)^ab (= K₁(R) for rings), sending a unit u to the class of the 1×1 matrix [u] in the abelianization of the stable general linear group (from the docstring, the name and the module documentation).
explanation: The body is Abelianization.of composed with rankOneUnits R. rankOneUnits R sends u to stage R 1 (scalar (Fin 1) u), the image of the 1×1 matrix [u] in StableGL R. So the composite sends u to the class of diag(u) in GL(R)^ab, which is exactly the standard map Rˣ → K₁(R). The construction needs no commutativity or negation; it only needs StableGL and the rank-one inclusion, which exist over a semiring. The semiring setting is therefore its natural generality. The library proves that the map splits the abelianized determinant over commutative rings and is injective there, as expected. Mathlib has no K₁ or stable GL, so there is no counterpart.
